preconditions.description: A test file named test-document.pdf must exist and be reachable by the browser file picker before the session begins

steps.description: On the My Files page, click the Share files button to open the Share files dialog

action.selector_hint: the Share files button in the top area of the My Files page — the exact label is unconfirmed; look for a prominent primary action button near the top of the page labelled Share, Share files, or similar

screenshot.focus: the Share files dialog or modal that opened, showing the upload area

steps.verify: A Share files dialog or modal is open and contains a visible upload area or drop zone

steps.description: Upload test-document.pdf using the file picker inside the Share files dialog and wait for the upload to complete

action.selector_hint: the upload area or drop zone inside the Share files dialog — click it to open the OS file picker, then select test-document.pdf

screenshot.focus: test-document.pdf listed in the dialog's file area with the upload progress indicator completed

steps.verify: test-document.pdf appears in the dialog's file list and the upload progress indicator has finished

steps.description: In the Add recipients field, type a recipient email address and confirm it by pressing Enter or clicking Add

action.selector_hint: the recipient email input field inside the Share files dialog — the exact label is unconfirmed; look for a field labelled Add recipients, Add people, or similar
action.confirm: Enter key or the Add button next to the field

screenshot.focus: testrecipient@example.com appearing as a recipient row in the dialog with a permission dropdown beside it

steps.verify: testrecipient@example.com is shown as a recipient row in the Share files dialog

steps.description: Open the permission level dropdown next to testrecipient@example.com and select Viewer

action.selector_hint: the permission level dropdown immediately to the right of testrecipient@example.com in the recipient list

screenshot.focus: the permission dropdown open showing Viewer, Contributor, and Co-Owner options with Viewer highlighted or selected

steps.verify: The permission dropdown for testrecipient@example.com shows Viewer, Contributor, and Co-Owner as options; Viewer is selected after the interaction

steps.description: Open the policy dropdown in the Share files dialog and select any available security policy

action.selector_hint: the policy or security policy dropdown inside the Share files dialog — look for a dropdown labelled Policy, Security policy, or similar

screenshot.focus: the policy dropdown open showing a list of available policy names

steps.verify: The policy dropdown lists at least one policy name; a policy is selected after the interaction

steps.description: If the selected policy requires phone verification, a phone number field appears next to the recipient — enter a phone number in international format; skip this step if no phone number field appears

action.selector_hint: the phone number input field next to testrecipient@example.com in the Share files dialog — only present when the selected policy requires SMS verification
action.conditional: only if a phone number field is visible next to the recipient row

screenshot.focus: the recipient row with +1 555 000 1234 entered in the phone number field, and the Share button becoming active

steps.verify: If a phone number field was visible: it contains +1 555 000 1234 and the Share button is now active. If no phone number field appeared: the Share button is already active and this step is a no-op

steps.description: Click the Share button to create the protected link and send the notification email to the recipient

action.selector_hint: the Share (or Confirm) primary action button at the bottom of the Share files dialog — the exact label is unconfirmed; look for the main submit button that is active once all required fields are filled

screenshot.focus: the confirmation screen or success state showing that the share was created and a protected link is displayed

steps.verify: A share confirmation screen or success message is displayed, showing a protected link for test-document.pdf

steps.description: On the share confirmation screen, click the Copy link button to copy the protected link to the clipboard

action.selector_hint: the Copy link button on the share confirmation screen — the exact label is unconfirmed; look for a button labelled Copy link, Copy, or similar next to the displayed protected link

screenshot.focus: the Copy link button and any visual feedback confirming the link was copied (e.g. button label change to Copied, a checkmark, or a toast notification)

steps.verify: Visual feedback confirms the link was copied to the clipboard — for example the button label changes to Copied, a checkmark appears, or a toast message is shown

steps.description: Close or dismiss the Share files dialog and return to the My Files page; confirm test-document.pdf appears in the file list with a share icon visible next to its name

action.selector_hint: close or dismiss button on the share confirmation screen, or the My Files navigation link — return to the My Files page and locate test-document.pdf in the file list

screenshot.focus: the My Files file list showing test-document.pdf with a share icon or sharing indicator next to its name

steps.verify: test-document.pdf is visible in the My Files list and has a share icon or sharing indicator next to its name

steps.description: Click the share icon next to test-document.pdf in the My Files list to open the Share & Permissions Drawer

action.selector_hint: the share icon (sharing indicator) immediately next to test-document.pdf in the My Files file list row

screenshot.focus: the Share & Permissions Drawer open on the right side of the page, showing testrecipient@example.com with a permission dropdown and the Parent policy dropdown at the top of the drawer

steps.verify: The Share & Permissions Drawer is open on the right side of the page and lists testrecipient@example.com with a Viewer permission dropdown and a Parent policy dropdown

postconditions.description: Delete test-document.pdf from SpecterX — from the My Files page, select test-document.pdf and delete it — to leave the tenant in a clean state
